content.short: Snowflake is a multisig wallet on Solana for teams and users.
content.description: Snowflake is a multisignature wallet built for teams on the Solana network. It enables teams to schedule payroll, manage recurring payments, and arrange future payments, all while providing real-time visibility into fiat values of assets and overall portfolio balances. The wallet enforces multi-party approval, requiring multiple team members to approve every transaction before it is executed, which helps prevent unauthorized access to company crypto assets.
content.meta: Snowflake is a multisig wallet platform built for Solana teams and users. Discover Snowflake and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
